lambda = 550nm, f/8: Airy disk diameter = 2.44 x 0.00055 x 8 = about 0.0107mm = 10.7um; if the pixel pitch exceeds 10.7um the diffraction limit is not yet reached at the pixel level.
map.：像素 4µm、400mm：像素级极限光圈 ≈ 像素×2.44×λ 反推约 f/: 4um pixels at 400mm: the pixel-level limit aperture is about f/29 back-calculated from pixel x 2.44 x lambda; apertures that small soften the image with diffraction, and f/8-f/11 is the usual landscape choice.
map.衍射使点成像为斑，直径 ∝ λ×f；光圈越小斑越大，超过像素尺寸即整体变软。: Diffraction turns a point image into a spot whose diameter scales with lambda x f; the smaller the aperture the larger the spot, and once it exceeds the pixel pitch the whole frame goes soft.
map.最佳光圈怎么选？: How do you choose the best aperture?
map.避开最大光圈像差与最小光圈衍射，多数镜头 f/5.6–f/11 锐度峰值。: Avoid aberration at the widest aperture and diffraction at the smallest; most lenses peak in sharpness around f/5.6-f/11.
